title: Rename a symbol across multiple files, keep tests green
prompt: This project defines a helper function named `computeTax` in `tax.js` and uses it from `invoice.js`. Rename that function from `computeTax` to `calculateTax` EVERYWHERE: its definition, its export, and every call site across all files. The test suite (`tax.test.js`) already expects the new name `calculateTax`. When you are done, `node --test` must pass AND the old name `computeTax` must not appear anywhere in the source. Do NOT modify the test file.
